intel.summary: Jhonathan Narvaez claimed Stage 2 with a sprint victory over Pogačar and Schachmann, taking the maglia rosa for Ineos after impressive team performance. UAE's pace on Colle Maddelena damaged GC contenders like Arensman and Foss, though Pogačar secured 14 seconds on rivals despite losing the stage sprint.
